descripcion_geo: Israel base camp west of the Jordan, near Jericho. First place where Israel camped in Canaan.
importancia_estrategica: First spiritual capital of Israel in Canaan; place of the first camp, the collective circumcision and the monument of twelve stones.

historias.titulo: The twelve stones of the Jordan in Gilgal
historias.descripcion: Israel raises twelve stones from the Jordan at Gilgal as a memorial of the miraculous crossing.
Joshua circumcises the entire generation born in the desert in Gilgal; 'Today I have removed from you the reproach of Egypt.'
Saul is presented to the people as king in Gilgal; Later he offers a sacrifice there that costs him the kingdom.

personajes.descripcion: He established Gilgal as a base of operations for the conquest of Canaan.
He was crowned and then judged in Gilgal; His disobedience there marked the end of his reign.
He made judicial circuits that included Gilgal; reprimanded Saul there.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Place of religious foundation: first circumcision in Canaan, first Passover in the promised land, first camp after the Jordan.

judaismo.descripcion: 'Today I have removed from you the reproach of Egypt' (Jos 5:9): the circumcision in Gilgal marks the new beginning of the liberated people.
judaismo.significado_teologico: 'Today I have removed from you the reproach of Egypt' (Jos 5:9): the circumcision in Gilgal marks the new beginning of the liberated people.
